response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS r, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avgn FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_ratio, SUM(g.n) AS total_records, AVG(g.n - a.avgn) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.n > a.avgn
